name: falling-platforms
description: Falling Platforms — a mobile multiplayer tap-to-hop game.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/shared build && concurrently -k -n server,client "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/server dev" "pnpm --filter @falling-platforms/client dev"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/client/e2e/playwright.config.ts
